object_description: two identical C-shaped buildings placed freely on the site beside a broken rectangular bar
design_condition: two C-shaped residential buildings sit freely in the middle of the site with their courtyards opening to the park, while a broken bar defines a built front along the road and the three together frame a public square

positive: Two identical C-shaped buildings house accommodation around semi-open courtyards overlooking the park
The broken rectangular bar seeks to define a built front along the road
The three buildings form a public square around which the collective programme is developed
On the east side the courtyards meet to form a spatial continuum with the park
The distinction between the different parts of the programme is clearly expressed in the differentiated plan forms
Foundations, structure, energy and sustainable development have been well understood and addressed
The compactness of the buildings and the recommended construction methods lead to an economical project
The layout of the student rooms is well resolved
The presentation is of high quality, in particular the landscape section linking the future district with the campus
negative: The three buildings appear self-sufficient and the main square struggles to be more than a transit area
It is hard to discern a sense of belonging to a greater whole than the building one lives in
Cold load-bearing concrete facades lead to costly insulating bracket solutions
The shape of the buildings is penalising for the absorption of seismic forces
The identity of the neighbourhood and the definition of outdoor spaces are hard to convince
The reading of the built forms and their random arrangement accentuate the urban disorder rather than resolving it
The close proximity of the hall facade and the residential corner shows an ambiguous relationship between two different compositions
The main square lacks spatial definition and remains very open
The layout produces many residual spaces
The height and proximity of the buildings give the whole a relatively imposing presence
The facade expression accentuated by the concrete structure creates an austere, administrative image
The distribution systems are seriously lacking in natural light
